parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State five features of Friday prayers (Jumu’ah).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the conditions needed for Friday prayers (Jumu’ah).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Muslims can find all the information they need for Friday prayers (Jumu’ah) in the Sunnah.’
Do you agree? Discuss this statement with reference to different points of view. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State five people whom a Muslim man should not marry, according to the Qur’an.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the freedom Muslims have to choose marital partners, according to Islamic law
(shariah).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Piety is the only consideration which matters when Muslims choose a marital partner.’
Do you agree? Discuss this statement with reference to different points of view. 
Section B
Answer EITHER Question 3 OR Question 4.
EITHER

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the ways in which the role of the Imam is different from that of the Caliph. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how a Sufi might rise through the spiritual stations towards union with God.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Compare the mystical approach of Sufism to other ways in which Muslims develop awareness
of God (taqwa).
